meta.name: ginkgo-cloud-lab
meta.description: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Bioworks Cloud Lab (cloud.ginkgo.bio), a web-based interface for autonomous lab execution on Reconfigurable Automation Carts (RACs). Use when the user wants to run protein expression and purification (cell-free, E. coli, or Pichia), HiBiT or A280 or LabChip quantification, IVT mRNA/circRNA synthesis, thermal shift / developability assays, Echo-MS enzyme or analyte methods, SPR target onboarding, fluorescent pixel art, or otherwise interact with Ginkgo Cloud Lab services. Covers protocol selection, input preparation, pricing, and ordering workflows.

copy.tagline: 在 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上提交和管理实验方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在云端自动化实验室运行生物实验流程。
copy.tagline_en: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Cloud Lab
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run automated lab experiments on a cloud platform.

howto.what: Claude 会帮您选择 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 的协议、准备输入、获取价格和提交订单，并可通过 EstiMate 评估自定义实验方案。
howto.when: 当您提到蛋白表达纯化、定量（HiBiT/A280/LabChip）、IVT mRNA/circRNA 合成、热位移分析、Echo-MS 或 SPR 目标接入等任务时触发。

say.text: 我想表达并纯化一个蛋白，从哪开始？
say.note: Claude 会推荐合适协议并引导下单。

say.text: 帮我用 EstiMate 评估一个自定义酶活性方案。
say.note: Claude 会描述给 EstiMate 并返回结果。

say.text: 细胞-free HiBiT 服务的价格和流程是什么？
say.note: Claude 会给出详情和订购步骤。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you select Ginkgo Cloud Lab protocols, prepare inputs, get pricing, submit orders, and use EstiMate to evaluate custom workflows.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention tasks like protein expression/purification, quantification (HiBiT/A280/LabChip), IVT mRNA/circRNA synthesis, thermal shift, Echo-MS, or SPR target onboarding.

say_en.text: I need to express and purify a protein, how to start?
say_en.note: Claude recommends a protocol and guides ordering.

say_en.text: Use EstiMate to evaluate a custom enzyme activity assay.
say_en.note: Claude describes it to EstiMate and returns results.

say_en.text: What is the price and process for cell-free HiBiT?
say_en.note: Claude provides details and ordering steps.
